title: Tetris Platformer -- Arrange your level, then jump to victory!
author: Visible-Key-1320
selftext:
[https://gemini.google.com/share/82a5daec6e7b](https://gemini.google.com/share/82a5daec6e7b)

Controls:

ARROW KEYS - Move the character  
WASD - Move the block.  
SPACE - Lock the block in place

Create a platforming environment to move the character (little white ball) to the coin. Blocks speed up as the game progresses, and the environment shifts when you collect enough coins.

Each block is a different element with different behavior:

   * FIRE blocks -- don't touch them, they'll kill you. Fire cells turn adjacent Earth cells into fire.
   * WATER blocks -- you can swim through them, and they turn adjacent fire cells into air blocks
   * AIR blocks -- they are collectible and fill your air meter. Double/triple/quadruple jumping depletes your air meter, but allows you to get higher
   * EARTH blocks -- solid platforms, susceptible to fire.
   * BOMB blocks -- when they hit a block, they will destroy ALL adjacent cells. they can be both useful or detrimental depending on how you use them.

Give it a shot, let me know what you think!
